name: storiesfly
description: TypeScript client for the StoriesFly API: Instagram and TikTok profiles, stories, posts, reels, videos without the watermark, comments, followers and following lists, reposts, hashtags, places and search, plus a download call. Also available in ChatGPT and Claude through MCP. No login, pay per request.

scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-build/test/*.test.js
scripts.readme:sync: npm run build && node scripts/readme-table.mjs sync
scripts.readme:check: npm run build && node scripts/readme-table.mjs check
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test && npm run openapi:check && npm run readme:check
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
